x: The female Anopheles mosquito spreads malaria. Aedes spreads dengue and chikungunya, Culex filariasis and Japanese encephalitis, and sandflies kala-azar.
t: Recall the vector of each disease.

x: Japanese encephalitis inflames the brain; it is spread by Culex mosquitoes from pigs and birds. The liver is hepatitis and salivary glands mumps.
t: Recall the organ affected by each disease.

x: Lack of vitamin A causes night blindness because the eye cannot make enough rhodopsin. Vitamin C lack causes scurvy and D rickets.
t: Recall the deficiency disease of each vitamin.

x: Option B is incorrect: gonorrhoea is sexually transmitted, not spread by droplets. The hepatitis-B, rabies and typhoid routes are right.
t: Recall the transmission route of each disease.

x: Both are true but R does not explain A: the Aedes mosquito spreads the virus, while the virus itself causes the platelet drop.
t: Check whether R explains the symptom or only the spread.

x: Both are true and R explains A: rabies attacks the nervous system, causing painful throat spasms that create fear of water (hydrophobia).
t: Check whether R is the cause of A.

x: Both are true: cholera and typhoid spread through contaminated food and water, and tetanus enters through dirty wounds.
t: Recall the transmission route of each disease.

x: Statement A is true: filarial worms block lymph vessels, causing elephantiasis. Statement B is false because Ascaris lives mainly in the small intestine.
t: Recall the organ affected by each worm.

x: All three are correct: rabies, Ebola and Nipah are viral diseases that pass from animals to humans (zoonoses).
t: Recall the zoonotic viral diseases.

x: I and II are correct: iodine lack causes goitre and vitamin D lack rickets. III is false because scurvy is from vitamin C lack; niacin lack causes pellagra.
t: Recall the deficiency disease of each nutrient.

x: Cholera is caused by Vibrio cholerae, typhoid by Salmonella typhi, diphtheria by Corynebacterium diphtheriae and TB by Mycobacterium tuberculosis, giving a-iii, b-iv, c-ii, d-i.
t: Recall the bacterium behind each disease.

x: Lack of B1 causes beriberi, protein kwashiorkor, energy and protein marasmus, and niacin pellagra, giving a-ii, b-iii, c-iv, d-i.
t: Recall the deficiency disease of each nutrient.

x: All four are fungal: athlete's foot, mucormycosis (black fungus) and aspergillosis are infections, and ergotism is poisoning from fungus-infected grain.
t: Recall the fungal diseases.

x: Polio is caused by poliovirus, COVID-19 by SARS-CoV-2, rabies by lyssavirus and hepatitis B by HBV, giving a-iv, b-i, c-iii, d-ii.
t: Recall the virus behind each disease.

x: All four are correct: polio is a human viral disease spread by the faecal–oral route that attacks the spinal cord and can paralyse.
t: Recall the facts about polio.

x: All five are correct: COVID-19 is a human viral disease spread by droplets and contact, attacking the lungs and sometimes many organs.
t: Recall the facts about COVID-19.

x: Rabies can be carried by dogs, cats, bats, foxes and other warm-blooded animals. Mosquitoes do not spread it.
t: Recall the hosts of rabies.

x: All three are correct: hepatitis B is a human viral disease that attacks the liver.
t: Recall the facts about hepatitis B.

x: All four are correct: mumps is a human viral disease caused by mumps virus and spread through saliva and nasal secretions.
t: Recall the facts about mumps.

x: Both are true: mumps spreads by contact and swells the parotid salivary glands.
t: Recall the organ affected by mumps.

x: Both are true and R explains A: dengue counts as a viral disease because it is caused by the dengue virus.
t: Check whether R is the cause of A.

x: All five are correct: chikungunya is a viral disease caused by CHIKV, spread by Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus bites, causing severe joint pain.
t: Recall the facts about chikungunya.

x: Zika is caused by Zika virus, is viral, spreads by mosquitoes, blood and sex, and causes fever, rash and joint pain, giving a-i, b-ii, c-iii, d-iv.
t: Recall the facts about Zika.

x: All six are correct: yellow fever is a viral disease spread by Aedes aegypti that causes fever and can turn haemorrhagic.
t: Recall the facts about yellow fever.

x: AIDS is caused by HIV, a retrovirus that destroys helper T cells. CHIKV, Zika and yellow fever viruses cause other diseases.
t: Recall the virus behind each disease.

x: All six are correct: AIDS is caused by the retrovirus HIV in humans, spreads through blood, sex and from mother to child, and destroys immunity.
t: Recall the facts about AIDS.

x: Option C is incorrect: Ebola passes from animals to humans and between humans, not from humans to animals. It causes haemorrhagic fever.
t: Check the direction of transmission.

x: Both are true: Nipah virus causes severe disease, and animals such as fruit bats and pigs host it and pass it to humans.
t: Recall the facts about Nipah.

x: All five are correct: measles is a highly contagious human viral disease spread through the air.
t: Recall the facts about measles.

x: Japanese encephalitis is caused by JEV, is viral, has pigs and wild birds as reservoirs and spreads by mosquito bite, giving a-ii, b-iii, c-iv, d-i.
t: Recall the facts about Japanese encephalitis.

x: Ranikhet disease is caused by a virus, rinderpest by a morbillivirus, bird flu by H5N1 and swine flu by H1N1, giving a-iv, b-i, c-ii, d-iii.
t: Recall the virus behind each animal disease.

x: Both are true: Ranikhet (Newcastle) disease is an infectious viral disease of poultry, and rinderpest a contagious viral disease of cattle.
t: Recall the facts about animal diseases.

x: All four are correct: chickens host Ranikhet disease, cattle and buffalo rinderpest, birds bird flu and pigs swine flu.
t: Recall the host of each animal disease.

x: Ranikhet affects poultry, rinderpest livestock, bird flu the respiratory system and swine flu is a type of influenza, giving a-ii, b-iii, c-iv, d-i.
t: Recall the key feature of each animal disease.

x: Both are true: bird flu is viral, can jump from birds to humans and occasionally between humans, and attacks the respiratory system.
t: Recall the facts about bird flu.

x: All four are correct: foot-and-mouth disease is an infectious viral disease (Aphthovirus) of cattle, goats, pigs and sheep.
t: Recall the facts about foot-and-mouth disease.

x: All three are correct: swine flu is viral influenza that attacks the respiratory system.
t: Recall the facts about swine flu.

x: Cholera is a bacterial disease of the small intestine, plague spreads through rat fleas and swells lymph nodes, foot-and-mouth affects cloven-hoofed animals and typhoid affects the gut, giving a-i, b-ii, c-iii, d-iv.
t: Recall the key feature of each disease.

x: All four are correct: leprosy is an infectious bacterial disease of humans caused by Mycobacterium leprae that damages skin and nerves.
t: Recall the facts about leprosy.

x: Option D is incorrect: pneumonia is mainly bacterial, especially Streptococcus pneumoniae, though viruses and fungi can also cause it. It is an infectious lung disease.
t: Check the main cause for a swapped word.

x: Diphtheria is a bacterial disease caused by Corynebacterium diphtheriae; it is prevented by the DPT vaccine.
t: Classify each disease by its pathogen.

x: Diphtheria is caused by Corynebacterium diphtheriae, gonorrhoea by Neisseria gonorrhoeae, syphilis by Treponema pallidum and pertussis by Bordetella pertussis, giving a-iv, b-iii, c-i, d-ii.
t: Recall the bacterium behind each disease.

x: All four are correct: diphtheria and pertussis are human diseases spread through the air, and gonorrhoea and syphilis are sexually transmitted bacterial diseases.
t: Recall the transmission of each disease.

x: Diphtheria affects the throat and nose, gonorrhoea the reproductive organs, syphilis the genitals, rectum and mouth, and pertussis causes whooping cough, giving a-iii, b-i, c-iv, d-ii.
t: Recall the organ affected by each disease.

x: Both are true and R explains A: tetanus is bacterial because it is caused by Clostridium tetani.
t: Check whether R is the cause of A.

x: Both are true: tetanus spores live in soil and enter through wounds, and the toxin causes muscle spasms.
t: Recall the facts about tetanus.

x: Tetanus toxin causes jaw spasms (lockjaw). Whooping cough is pertussis, and reproductive-organ effects belong to gonorrhoea and syphilis.
t: Recall the key symptom of tetanus.

x: All three are correct: tuberculosis is a human bacterial disease spread through the air.
t: Recall the facts about tuberculosis.

x: Tuberculosis mainly attacks the lungs, though it can spread to other organs.
t: Recall the organ affected by tuberculosis.

x: Rheumatic fever is caused by Streptococcus pyogenes in humans, affects the heart, brain, joints and skin, and follows a throat infection, giving a-iv, b-i, c-iii, d-ii.
t: Recall the facts about rheumatic fever.

x: Both are true and R explains A: botulism is an intoxication because its effects come from the toxin of Clostridium botulinum.
t: Check whether R is the cause of A.

x: Both are true: botulism comes from contaminated food, wounds and in infants, and spreads through food and wounds.
t: Recall the routes of botulism.

x: I and II are correct: botulinum toxin blocks nerves and can cause paralysis. III is false because the liver is not its target.
t: Recall the organ affected by botulism.

x: All four are correct: malaria is a protozoan disease caused by Plasmodium, spread by mosquitoes and by blood, that attacks the liver and red cells and enlarges the spleen.
t: Recall the facts about malaria.

x: Kala-azar is caused by Leishmania, is protozoan, has dogs as a reservoir and can also spread through blood and needles, giving a-iv, b-ii, c-i, d-iii.
t: Recall the facts about kala-azar.

x: Kala-azar attacks the liver, spleen and bone marrow, sleeping sickness the brain in later stages, amoebiasis the intestine and schistosomiasis the urinary tract and gut, giving a-i, b-ii, c-iii, d-iv.
t: Recall the organ affected by each parasite.

x: Both are true and R explains A: sleeping sickness is protozoan because it is caused by the protozoan Trypanosoma brucei.
t: Check whether R is the cause of A.

x: Sleeping sickness spreads by tsetse fly bite, amoebiasis through dirty food and water, schistosomiasis through snails in unsafe water and fascioliasis through raw water plants, giving a-i, b-ii, c-iii, d-iv.
t: Recall the transmission of each parasite.

x: All five are correct: fascioliasis is caused by the liver fluke Fasciola, mainly in ruminants, caught from raw water plants, and damages the liver and bile ducts.
t: Recall the facts about fascioliasis.

x: Zika is spread by Aedes, Japanese encephalitis by Culex, plague is caused by Yersinia pestis and syphilis has humans as host, giving a-iv, b-ii, c-iii, d-i.
t: Recall the key feature of each disease.

x: Both are true and R explains A: amoebiasis is protozoan because it is caused by the protozoan Entamoeba histolytica.
t: Check whether R is the cause of A.

x: Both are true: schistosomiasis is caused by Schistosoma, a parasitic flatworm (blood fluke).
t: Recall the cause of schistosomiasis.

x: All five are correct: neurocysticercosis comes from swallowing Taenia solium eggs in dirty food or water, and its larvae lodge in the human brain.
t: Recall the facts about neurocysticercosis.

x: Both are true and R explains A: filariasis is a nematode disease because Wuchereria bancrofti is a roundworm.
t: Check whether R is the cause of A.

x: Both are true: filariasis spreads through the bites of Culex mosquitoes.
t: Recall the vector of filariasis.

x: All four are correct: ascariasis is a nematode infection by Ascaris lumbricoides, caught by swallowing its eggs.
t: Recall the facts about ascariasis.

x: Athlete's foot is a ringworm-type infection caused by the fungi Trichophyton, Epidermophyton and Microsporum.
t: Recall the fungi behind athlete's foot.

x: Athlete's foot infects humans, mucormycosis is caused by Mucormycetes, aspergillosis by Aspergillus and ergotism by Claviceps toxin, giving a-i, b-ii, c-iii, d-iv.
t: Recall the fungus behind each disease.

x: All four are correct: athlete's foot spreads by contaminated floors and towels and affects foot skin, and mucormycosis comes from the environment and attacks the nose, sinuses, eyes and brain.
t: Recall the facts about fungal infections.

x: Both are true but R does not explain A: the range of hosts does not explain why aspergillosis can be respiratory or systemic.
t: Check whether R is a cause or a parallel fact.

x: All three are correct: ergotism comes from eating rye or grain infected by the ergot fungus, and it affects nerves, blood vessels and hormones.
t: Recall the facts about ergotism.

x: All five are correct: cancer is uncontrolled cell growth linked to oncogene mutations, it is not contagious, can arise in any organ and can spread (metastasis).
t: Recall the facts about cancer.

x: Leukaemia is non-contagious overproduction of abnormal white cells in bone marrow and blood. Option D wrongly calls cancer contagious.
t: Recall the facts about leukaemia.

x: Both are true: goitre is an iodine-deficiency disease of the thyroid, and beriberi a vitamin B1 deficiency.
t: Recall the deficiency diseases.

x: All four are correct: kwashiorkor is protein deficiency affecting growth and the liver, and marasmus is energy-and-protein deficiency causing severe wasting.
t: Discriminate kwashiorkor from marasmus.

x: Both are true: night blindness is a vitamin A deficiency of the eye, and rickets a vitamin D deficiency of the bones.
t: Recall the deficiency diseases.

x: Scurvy affects gums and connective tissue, pellagra the skin, gut and nerves, cancer any organ with metastasis and leukaemia the bone marrow and blood, giving a-ii, b-iv, c-iii, d-i.
t: Recall the organs affected by each disease.

x: Beriberi (lack of thiamine) damages the heart (wet beriberi) and nerves (dry beriberi). Gums are scurvy and bones rickets.
t: Recall the organs affected by beriberi.

x: Pertussis (whooping cough) is a bacterial disease caused by Bordetella pertussis and is prevented by the DPT vaccine.
t: Classify each disease by its pathogen.

x: Both are true and R explains A: kala-azar is linked to sandflies because sandfly bites spread Leishmania.
t: Check whether R is the cause of A.
